verses.28:34: وَأَخِي هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانࣰ ا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِيَ رِدۡءࣰ ا يُصَدِّقُنِيٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

meaning: The root فصح (fSH) primarily means clarity and distinctness. It describes things becoming clear, like urine or milk, and extends to clear speech.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
